name: lv_obj_scroll_to_y

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-9-pro-3.1.190 image: sub_C242CA0 deletes the scroll animation of the object, reads the current vertical scroll (sub_C23BD02) and calls lv_obj_scroll_by (sub_C2425D8) with (0, current - y, anim); its x sibling is the one the Lua scroll_to binding calls for both axes.

notes: (obj, y, anim_enable). The v8 Manager uses it to put a re-rendered page back at the top. Not device probed.
